name: Stormbringer: Gift of Air empowers the Air Elemental and extends Tailwind (#755)
contract: #755 Gift of Air (705715) promises two things: casting Kiss of the Clouds empowers the Air Elemental with Gift of Air (804033), and the Stormbringer's critical strikes extend Tailwind (804035) by 1.5 seconds. 705715 is a SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL passive with ProcFlags = 0, so no proc entry is generated and 804033 never fires; the critical-strike clause is carried by 583254 (SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_AURA_DURATION, EffectMiscValue[0] = 804035), which no acquirable spell reaches. One spell_proc row plus aura_ascension_gift_of_air deliver both clauses. Expected values come from the effective DBC: 804033 EffectBasePoints[1] = 19 plus EffectDieSides[1] = 1 gives 20% damage done, EffectAmplitude[2] = 2000 ms for the periodic heal, DurationIndex 9 (SpellDuration.Duration = 30000); 583254 EffectBasePoints[0] = 1499 plus EffectDieSides[0] = 1 gives exactly 1500 ms, and its TARGET_SRC_CASTER / TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_ALLY pair covers the caster. Kiss of the Clouds is selected by family 22 with SpellFamilyFlags[2] = 0x100000. Tailwind is a cast spell, not a passive, so the fixture has to learn 804035 before casting it (the harness cast record reports spell_active false otherwise) and has to carry 804035's CasterAuraSpell 681016 'At Least 20 Static', the Stormbringer resource threshold aura, or Spell::CheckCast answers SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURASTATE; stormbringer-fix-unshackle-family-wrath-of-alakir.json uses the same learn plus 803102/681016 idiom.
